structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun coin named "america.gov" ($AMERICA), launched about 13 minutes before detection and already migrated to PumpSwap. It is riding real news: Bloomberg, Fox and KuCoin reported on 2026-09-25 that Trump and Vance will launch America.gov, a one-stop federal website with AI tools, at a DC event with Musk and Jensen Huang. The coin shot up to about $575k ATH, crashed 73% in 5 minutes, and at T2 sat at about $142-147k with $33k liquidity. A same-name, same-ticker token (pwfAe…) launched about 9.5 hours earlier is at $407k with $70k liquidity, so it is the bigger and older incumbent.
